title: perf(switchboard): batch document loads on startup
description:
Startup loaded documents one query at a time; it now batches them 100 per query.
Cold start on the staging dataset drops from 41 s to 9 s.

testing.notes: 41 s to 9 s on the staging dataset

steps: Start switchboard against a staging snapshot
Open the drive list and confirm every drive loads

riskNote: A batch that fails now fails all 100 documents in it instead of one.
head: perf/switchboard-batch-load
